
### title: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->title }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->title)
@endif

### url: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->url }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->url)
@endif

### published_at: date
--- Date
{{ $entry->published_at?->translatedFormat('j F Y') }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->published_at)
@endif

### author: user
--- Name
{{ $entry->author?->name }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->author)
@endif

### terms: list<term>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($entry->terms as $item)
    @php($item->resolveFor($locale))
    <a href="{{ $item->url }}">{{ $item->name }}</a>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if ($entry->terms->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### slug: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->slug }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->slug)
@endif

### summary: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->get('summary') }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->get('summary'))
@endif

### notes: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->get('notes') }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->get('notes'))
@endif

### body: html
--- Rich text
{!! $entry->get('body') !!}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->get('body'))
@endif

### price: number
--- Text
{{ $entry->get('price') }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->get('price'))
@endif

### featured: bool
--- Only when it is on
@if ($entry->get('featured'))
@endif
--- Only when it is off
@if (! $entry->get('featured'))
@endif

### colour: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->get('colour') }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->get('colour'))
@endif

### sizes: list<text>
--- All of them, with commas
{{ implode(', ', (array) ($entry->get('sizes') ?? [])) }}
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($entry->get('sizes') ?? [] as $size)
    {{ $size }}
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($entry->get('sizes'))->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### made_on: date
--- Date
{{ $entry->get('made_on')?->translatedFormat('j F Y') }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->get('made_on'))
@endif

### more: link
--- Link
@if (($more = $entry->get('more')) && ! empty($more['url']))
    <a href="{{ $more['url'] }}" @if (! empty($more['new_tab'])) target="_blank" rel="noopener" @endif>{{ $more['label'] ?: $more['url'] }}</a>
@endif
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->get('more'))
@endif

### cover: asset
--- Image
@if ($cover = $entry->get('cover'))
    <img src="{{ $cover->url('large') }}" alt="{{ $cover->alt }}">
@endif
--- Link to the file
@if ($cover = $entry->get('cover'))
    <a href="{{ $cover->url() }}">{{ $cover->title ?: $cover->filename }}</a>
@endif
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->get('cover'))
@endif

### photos: list<asset>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($entry->get('photos') ?? [] as $photo)
    <img src="{{ $photo->url('large') }}" alt="{{ $photo->alt }}">
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($entry->get('photos'))->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### related: list<entry(articles)>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($entry->get('related') ?? [] as $article)
    <a href="{{ $article->url }}">{{ $article->title }}</a>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($entry->get('related'))->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### see_also: list<entry>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($entry->get('see_also') ?? [] as $item)
    <a href="{{ $item->url }}">{{ $item->title }}</a>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($entry->get('see_also'))->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### topics: list<term(topics)>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($entry->get('topics') ?? [] as $topic)
    <a href="{{ $topic->url }}">{{ $topic->name }}</a>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($entry->get('topics'))->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### details: group{material, weight, picture}

### steps: list<row{label, text, icon}>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($entry->get('steps') ?? [] as $step)
    <div>
        {{ $step['label'] ?? '' }}
        {!! $step['text'] ?? '' !!}
        @if ($icon = $step['icon'] ?? null)
            <img src="{{ $icon->url('large') }}" alt="{{ $icon->alt }}">
        @endif
    </div>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($entry->get('steps'))->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### sections: list<block(hero|text|cta)>
--- Each block, drawn by its own template
@foreach ($entry->get('sections') ?? [] as $block)
    @includeFirst(['sunrice.blocks.'.$block->type, 'sunrice.blocks.default'], ['block' => $block])
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($entry->get('sections'))->isNotEmpty())
@endif
